subject.title: OpenWebUI image uploads reach image tool as empty image via /v1/chat/completions on 2026.5.18

question: Should this issue wait for a redacted OpenWebUI image-upload request capture before any fix PR, or should a maintainer sponsor a live OpenWebUI repro from current main/latest release?
rationale: Current source already supports standard `image_url` input, and without the actual OpenWebUI payload an automated repair would guess at the unsupported or empty conversion path.

options.title: Request redacted payload capture
options.body: Ask for a ccglass or equivalent redacted `/v1/chat/completions` request capture and Gateway trace before allowing a fix PR.

options.title: Sponsor live repro
options.body: Have a maintainer run OpenWebUI against current main/latest release with an image upload and use that trace as the repair target.

options.title: Close only if client omitted media
options.body: If proof shows OpenWebUI never sends image content to OpenClaw, close or reroute with an external-client explanation instead of patching OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Request redacted payload capture
recommendation.body: Ask for a ccglass or equivalent redacted `/v1/chat/completions` request capture and Gateway trace before allowing a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the most relevant current gateway history for the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions image path.
